title: design/link.md Browser clock section; tools and concepts docs for serve --link
description:
## Intent
Docs and design note for the browser path.

## Steps
1. `design/link.md`: "Browser clock" section: the sequence diagram, message schema, ping rate and offset filter, tolerance, which browsers are supported, why the cloud app has no Link (M0 finding).
2. `docs/tools.md`: `apricity serve --library <dir> --link` in the web app section; what the Link control does.
3. `docs/concepts.md` "Playing beside a DAW over Link": a paragraph for the web app.

## Verify
`npm --prefix web run build`; `grep -n "Browser clock" design/link.md`.

Commit: `docs(<this task id>)`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
